preservation_methodology_distinction.speech_classes: Active speech segments (contiguous non-padding audio) are bit-exact preserved in value and order (diff = 0.0). Outer zero-padding is intentionally repositioned to evaluate alignment sensitivity; the entire 1.0s file is therefore not bit-exact across alignments by design.
preservation_methodology_distinction.silence_class: Full 16,000-sample ambient background recordings are bit-exact preserved in their entirety (diff = 0.0, whole-file SHA-256 matches 50/50). Because ambient fixtures have no defensible onset, they were deliberately left unshifted.

class_semantic_definition.name: SILENCE (Ambient Background Fixture)
class_semantic_definition.description: Synthetic ambient room noise and low-amplitude pseudo-random dither spanning 16,000 samples. Strictly non-zero (mean RMS 0.002082), distinct from digital silence (0.0 flatline).
class_semantic_definition.onset_status: No defensible acoustic onset. 25 clips have zero samples >= 0.005; 25 clips contain sporadic noise spikes. Transform deliberately preserves full 16,000 buffer unshifted without centering.
class_semantic_definition.label_policy_note: Retains historical 'SILENCE' label for dictionary compatibility with trained checkpoints and benchmark manifests. Recommended future label in production pipelines: 'BACKGROUND' or 'AMBIENT_NOISE'.

comparison_with_buggy_a2_b2.scientific_interpretation: Equal model predictions (300/300) do NOT imply acoustic equivalence between the truncated buggy audio and intact full-buffer audio. The TC-ResNet-14 models classified both representations as SILENCE because in both cases the low-level signal energy remained strictly below the detection thresholds for all target keyword classes.
